all_spaces.description: the boundary field of an all-spaces grant: the key covers every space in the account, including spaces created later (the tech space excepted). Never infer the boundary from spaces

permission.description: the compact form agents string-match on

restricted.description: The key reaches only the spaces listed: scoped, and not all_spaces. False for a legacy key and for an all-spaces grant alike

scoped.description: A grant record exists. An all-spaces grant is scoped too; branch on restricted for the space boundary

space_count.description: For an all-spaces grant: how many live spaces the key covers now, zero included. spaces lists them only when the spaces parameter is true

spaces.description: the granted spaces of a restricted key; for an all-spaces grant, the current live spaces when the spaces parameter is true, else empty

id.description: An identifier of the key record, the one the key list in Settings shows: the hex sha256 of the key's raw bytes, never the token itself

key_status.description: Credential kind: scoped means a grant record exists (all-spaces grants included), legacy means none. Use grant.restricted for the space boundary

200.description: The key's grant, as it is enforced

see_also.description: The operations the hint names, as data: each renders in the hint as its method and path with params substituted and `?k=v` query sorted by key, so a caller with tools instead of routes can find and replace it by op.

op.description: The operation's OpenAPI operationId, such as list_properties; absent means the request that produced this issue, resent with the query given, and the hint then spells only the query.

params.description: Path parameters by their OpenAPI name, each substituted into the path once and verbatim (no percent-encoding); one left out keeps its {name} placeholder in the hint for the caller to fill.

query.description: Query parameters to send with the operation, spelled in the hint as ?name=value pairs joined by & and sorted by name, values verbatim.

400.description: Invalid path, query or request input

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired key; shared authentication envelope
